# Item 1 — clustered statistics (generated by item1_clustered.py)

Fact CI = bootstrap over facts (paper's method; recomputed here with B = 2000, so it can differ from the paper's B = 1000 interval by ±0.1 pp of Monte-Carlo noise). Cluster CI = repositories resampled with replacement (B = 2000), all facts of a drawn repo kept, pooled ratio-of-sums. Repo mean = each repository's own pooled rate, averaged with equal weight (CI: bootstrap over repositories). LORO = min / max of the pooled estimate when one repository is dropped (the repo giving the extreme in parentheses).
